findings.evidence: STATUS.md: "Nothing splits the coordinate ring by idempotents to produce `G°`, and finiteness of `π₀` under smoothness is untried." Precedent for stopping short: AffineGroupScheme/Smooth.lean ends at smoothAffineGroupSchemeProperty_inverseImage (line 128, `end TauCeti`) with no SmoothAffineGroupSchemeCat and no restricted equivalence; grep for SmoothAffineGroupSchemeCat returns nothing. FiniteTypeAffineGroupSchemeCat by contrast has consumers (Components/Finite.lean:44). The new GeometricallyConnectedAffineGroupSchemeCat has none.

findings.issue: Periphery around a target that is not getting closer. The connectedness lane already has six merged pieces citing the same Layer 3 milestone (Connected/CommHopfAlgCat.lean, Connected/AlgebraicallyClosed.lean, Connected/BaseChange.lean, AffineGroupScheme/Connected.lean, AffineGroupScheme/Components/Finite.lean, Topology/NoetherianSpace/ConnectedComponents.lean) and STATUS.md records that nothing yet produces G° or π₀. This PR adds no new mathematics: geometricallyConnectedAffineGroupSchemeProperty_inverseImage transports the already-merged geometricallyConnectedCommHopfAlg_iff_geometricallyConnected_hopfSpec, and the equivalence is congrFullSubcategory applied to it; the _iff lemmas and the private functorCompιIso are Iff.rfl / Iso.refl.

findings.issue: The description overstates roadmap support: it cites the milestone's requirement "that Hopf-algebra closed subgroups stay synchronized with affine group schemes". README.md:153-154 asks for the Hopf-ideal ↔ closed-subgroup-scheme anti-equivalence, which is already merged (CommHopfAlgCat.hopfIdealOrderIsoClosedSubgroup); nothing in Layer 3 asks for full subcategories of connected objects, and Layer 0 (README.md:120) says predicates should be "kept as predicates, not baked into the category".

summary: The Layer 3 target "Identity component G° and component group π₀(G)" is real and correctly cited, but this is the seventh merged satellite around it while the target itself is untouched — no idempotent splitting, no G°, no π₀. The PR adds only formal categorical transport of a comparison theorem already on main, with no consumer in the repo.
